description: This bar chart, titled “Researcher Location,” illustrates the number of datasets associated with different researcher locations over a period from 2012 to 2022, with the vertical axis representing the “Number of datasets” on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2, and the horizontal axis labeled “Year” showing yearly increments. In 2021, the “Other” bar is the tallest at approximately 10^2, followed by the “USA” (orange) bar at around 10^1, and the “IT” (purple) bar at approximately 10^0.
